meta.purpose: Decision-option comparison and comprehensive risk matrix covering Business-as-Usual (BAU) risks, Rare Black-Swan tail events, and Simultaneous Compound Hazard Stress.

decision_options.wealth_preservation: High — eliminates single-parcel seismic/fire tail risk, tenant closure risk, and 2030–2035 vacancy cliff immediately.
decision_options.growth_opportunity: Moderate — redeploys net proceeds into diversified liquid or higher-growth assets, but suffers taxable drag (30%–40%+ of gain) and short-lease buyer cap-rate discount.
decision_options.key_risks: Tax leakage (§1250 + Fed LTCG + NIIT + CA 13.3% + potential Measure ULA >$5M); buyer financing discount if <6 yrs remain; leaving upside on table if site is prime infill land.
decision_options.when_optimal: Best if store rent-to-sales is weak (>9.5%), parcel has high seismic/environmental capex exposure, or owner needs immediate liquidity.

decision_options.wealth_preservation: Very High — preserves 100% of pre-tax equity (avoiding Fed/CA/recapture tax) while diversifying out of a single QSR brand and single LA fault/wildfire basin.
decision_options.growth_opportunity: High — swaps into 15–20 yr investment-grade NNN or multi-tenant/geographic-diversified real estate with stronger rent bumps.
decision_options.key_risks: Strict 45-day ID / 180-day close clock can pressure overpayment for replacement property; Measure ULA (if >$5M in LA City) still applies at sale closing; QI counterparty risk.
decision_options.when_optimal: Often the strongest wealth-preservation + growth balance if basis is low (large embedded tax hit) and remaining lease term still attracts 1031/financed buyers (5–9 yrs left).

decision_options.option: 3. Negotiate Early 'Blend-and-Extend' Renewal Now (Hold or Sell Extended)
decision_options.wealth_preservation: High (if achieved on strong credit) — locks in 10–15+ yr cash-flow visibility and restores institutional buyer financing eligibility.
decision_options.growth_opportunity: High — cap-rate compression from extending a short lease to 15 years often creates immediate capital value exceeding TI concessions, preserving optionality to hold OR sell/1031 at peak pricing.
decision_options.key_risks: Prematurely approaching tenant before checking store sales can invite a rent-reduction demand; franchisee may demand heavy remodel/drive-thru TI allowance.
decision_options.when_optimal: Best when PARCEL-001 has healthy store sales (<8% rent-to-sales) and strong arterial traffic, giving the tenant high switching costs.

decision_options.wealth_preservation: Low-to-Moderate — collects current NNN rent and keeps low Prop 13 tax base, but concentrates 100% of binary non-renewal and short-fuse illiquidity risk.
decision_options.growth_opportunity: Bimodal — strong ONLY if contract rent is far below market AND parcel land/re-leasing demand is exceptional; severely negative if tenant vacates a specialized QSR pad.
decision_options.key_risks: Every passing year shrinks buyer LTV and widens exit cap rate; if tenant declines option with 6–12 months notice, landlord faces 12–24 months dark carry, taxes, insurance, vandalism, and $300k–$800k+ re-tenanting TI.
decision_options.when_optimal: Justifiable only when verified ZIMAS/infill land value or mark-to-market retail rent substantially exceeds leased-fee QSR value.

decision_options.option: 5. Hold to Expiry & Reposition / Covered-Land Redevelopment
decision_options.wealth_preservation: Low (high execution, entitlement, construction & financing risk).
decision_options.growth_opportunity: Very High (upside case) — unlocks dense multifamily/mixed-use TOC/PDA land value or higher-credit drive-thru replacement tenant.
decision_options.key_risks: Entitlement delays, construction cost inflation, loss of grandfathered drive-thru rights if use lapses, environmental remediation discovery, and zero income during development.
decision_options.when_optimal: Only for well-capitalized owners when private ZIMAS audit proves high-tier TOC/PDA density and land value clearly dwarfs existing NNN valuation.

risk_register.risk: Tenant system comp-sales deterioration & 'JACK on Track' store closures
risk_register.evidence: Jack in the Box franchise SSS fell -4.5% (Q2'25), -7.2% (Q3'25), -7.6% (Q4'25), -7.0% (Q1'26); 86 closures in FY25 + 50–100 guided for FY26.
risk_register.mitigation: Obtain 3-year unit sales & rent-to-sales ratio before assuming renewal; consider early 1031 exit or blend-and-extend while >4–5 yrs remain.

risk_register.risk: Franchisee store-margin squeeze from $20.00/hr CA fast-food wage & utility/food inflation
risk_register.evidence: CA AB 1228 mandates $20.00/hr for chains >=60 units; JACK company restaurant margin fell 710 bps YoY (23.2% → 16.1% in Q1 FY2026).
risk_register.mitigation: Underwrite renewal rent against realistic 15%–17% store EBITDAR margins, not 2021–2023 peak margins.

risk_register.risk: Competing corporate real-estate dispositions expanding QSR NNN supply
risk_register.evidence: Q1 FY2026 8-K Note 4 states JACK expects 'higher than normal sales of real estate in an effort to pay down debt'.
risk_register.mitigation: Differentiate PARCEL-001 on Central LA infill land value and drive-thru scarcity; avoid listing blind without extended term or land story.

risk_register.risk: Short-lease ('wasting asset') buyer debt cliff as 2030–2035 approaches
risk_register.evidence: With 10Y Treasury at 4.91% (2026-11-24), commercial lenders restrict LTV/amortization once remaining firm lease term drops under 5–7 years.
risk_register.mitigation: Act at least 5–6 years prior to firm expiry (i.e., now if expiry is 2030–2031) so buyers can still secure standard 5-to-7 year commercial debt.

risk_register.risk: Prop 13 reassessment shock upon sale eroding tenant rent-paying capacity
risk_register.evidence: Under Prop 13 (BOE Pub 29), sale resets property taxes from historical base to 1% + bonds on current sale price, directly billed to NNN tenant.
risk_register.mitigation: Calculate post-sale property tax per sq ft and add to base rent to test buyer/tenant occupancy-cost tolerance.

risk_register.risk: Real rent erosion when fixed NNN escalations lag Los Angeles CPI (+3.7%)
risk_register.evidence: BLS Sept 2026 LA CPI-U is +3.7% YoY (CPI-W +4.1%); flat or 1%/yr bumps lose 10%–18% of real purchasing power over 5–10 years.
risk_register.mitigation: Target CPI-linked or >=2.0%–2.5% annual / 10%–12% 5-year bumps in any negotiated renewal.

risk_register.risk: City of LA Measure ULA gross-proceeds transfer tax cliff above $5M
risk_register.evidence: LAHD confirms special transfer tax on City of LA real property conveyances exceeding $5M base threshold (applied to gross price, not gain).
risk_register.mitigation: Verify municipal boundary (City of LA vs unincorporated/neighboring city) and price proximity to CPI-adjusted ULA threshold before setting asking price.

risk_register.risk: Major Los Angeles earthquake (M>=6.7 to M>=7.5) + liquefaction / casualty lease termination
risk_register.evidence: USGS UCERF3 30-year LA region probability is 60% for M>=6.7, 46% for M>=7.0, and 31% for M>=7.5; CGS maps liquefaction across LA basin sediments.
risk_register.mitigation: Verify CGS EQ ZApp status + building seismic vintage; check lease casualty-termination threshold (often >25%–50% damage in final lease years lets tenant walk!).

risk_register.risk: Urban-interface conflagration / catastrophic smoke, grid outage & regional insurance retreat
risk_register.evidence: CA DOF E-1 documents 11,160 LA housing units destroyed in the 2025 Eaton & Palisades fires; CDI reports 677,449 FAIR Plan policies across 662 distressed ZIPs.
risk_register.mitigation: Screen CAL FIRE 2025 LRA FHSZ; audit commercial property & 18–24 mo business-interruption/loss-of-rent coverage and carrier renewal terms.

risk_register.risk: Atmospheric-river extreme urban flooding / stormwater inundation
risk_register.evidence: FEMA NFHL effective + pending maps govern lender flood mandates; urban sheet-flow flooding can halt ground-floor QSR kitchen operations even in Zone X.
risk_register.mitigation: Check FEMA MSC effective & preliminary flood layers, street-grade drainage, and flood sub-limits in commercial property policy.

risk_register.risk: Legacy subsurface environmental plume (historical gas station / auto / dry cleaner on corner pad)
risk_register.evidence: Corner drive-thru QSR pads in Central LA frequently occupied mid-century service stations; subsurface contamination freezes conventional lender closings.
risk_register.mitigation: Run historical Sanborn/city-directory desktop screen privately before listing; never grant invasive Phase II rights without strict indemnification.

risk_register.risk: Corridor transit construction, median/curb-cut elimination, or partial condemnation
risk_register.evidence: QSR drive-thru volume depends acutely on right-in/right-out arterial access; leases often grant tenant rent abatement or termination upon access loss.
risk_register.mitigation: Check Metro/LADOT capital project corridors and audit the condemnation/access-impairment clause in Gate G-02.

compound_stress.exit_cap_shift: 0 to +50 bps if renewed; +75 to +150 bps if left unextended <5 yrs
compound_stress.liquidity_impact: Normal 60–120 day marketing window with conventional debt if >=6–7 yrs term.

compound_stress.scenario: BAU Downside: Tenant Non-Renewal + Dark Re-Tenanting
compound_stress.rent_loss_months: 12–18 months lost rent + 100% NNN tax/insurance/security carry
compound_stress.uninsured_capex_pct: 10%–20% of value ($250k–$600k+ TI, facade de-imaging, roof/HVAC, leasing commissions)
compound_stress.exit_cap_shift: +125 to +225 bps vacant-box discount (unless land floor supports value)
compound_stress.liquidity_impact: Cash/bridge/value-add buyers only; conventional NNN financing unavailable while dark.

compound_stress.scenario: Compound Black Swan: M7.0 Earthquake OR Severe Fire/Flood + Casualty Termination in Final Lease Years
compound_stress.rent_loss_months: 18–30 months rent abatement / lease cancellation under late-term casualty clause
compound_stress.uninsured_capex_pct: 15%–35% of building replacement cost (seismic deductible / code-upgrade gap)
compound_stress.exit_cap_shift: +150 to +300 bps + regional insurance moratorium / lender freeze
compound_stress.liquidity_impact: Exit liquidity temporarily frozen or discounted to raw encumbered land value; single-asset owner bears 100% of shock.
